text: There are few people whom I really love, and still fewer of whom I think well. The more I see of the world, the more am I dissatisfied with it.
author: Jane Austen

archive.text: The word happy would lose its meaning if it were not balanced by sadness.
archive.author: Carl Jung

archive.text: What really matters is what you do with what you have.
archive.author: H. G. Wells

archive.text: Conquer anger with non-anger. Conquer badness with goodness. Conquer meanness with generosity.
archive.author: Gautama Buddha

archive.text: The artist must know the manner whereby to convince others of the truthfulness of his lies.
archive.author: Pablo Picasso

archive.text: Do not let the behavior of others destroy your inner peace.
archive.author: Dalai Lama

archive.text: The more light you allow within you, the brighter the world you live in will be.
archive.author: Shakti Gawain

archive.text: Search others for their virtues, thyself for thy vices.
archive.author: Benjamin Franklin
